chapter_title: High School Entrance Exam Results Released

segments.title: High School Entrance Exam Results Released
segments.content:
June 28th, three o'clock in the morning.

Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong were already awake, but they were still lying in bed, not having gotten up to wash.

"We've been to Wei Dongrong's side, and we've also seen my younger uncle's apartment." Lin Xiuhong turned her head to look at her husband. "What are you thinking now?"

"About Wei Dongrong's side, I'm not so sure." Li Guohong frowned. "We've both seen that plot of land of his."

"The location is actually quite remote, also in the northern part of Yinjiang District, almost close to the national highway."

"I'm just a bit unsure right now."

Lin Xiuhong nodded in agreement. "From Wei Dongrong's introduction, Yinjiang District will focus on developing that area in the future. Once the houses are built, there'll be no problem selling them."

"I was just thinking, if that's really the case, wouldn't the house over by the First Affiliated High School have even greater potential?"

"After all, Qianjiang University is over there."

Li Guohong pondered for a moment, then continued, "But Wei Dongrong's side is mainly an investment. The house itself doesn't have much to do with us; we're just collecting interest."

"If we buy my younger uncle's apartment, whether we make a profit or a loss will be completely tied to the housing prices."

"We haven't heard anything about the subway these past few days either. We don't know if what that kid Li Luo said is reliable."

Upon the mention of Li Luo, Lin Xiuhong's expression first relaxed. Thinking about her son's changes these past few days made her feel quite warm inside.

But then she frowned again, worrying, "It's the 28th today. I remember the results are supposed to be out in the morning, right?"

"Right." Reminded by her, Li Guohong also remembered, then said with a chuckle, "If this kid of ours actually manages to get into the First Affiliated High School, should we just buy your uncle's apartment directly?"

"You actually believe him." Lin Xiuhong shot him a look. "Although the boy has become a lot more sensible recently, he only had Xixi help him review the day before the exam. It'll be good enough if he can get into one of those ordinary high schools with lower score requirements."

"I was just saying." Li Guohong shook his head. "You've got to have some hope, right? What if."

"Exams aren't like buying a lottery ticket." Lin Xiuhong sighed. "If only he had been sensible a bit earlier during his three years of middle school and studied more with Xixi, then I would definitely believe in our son's brains. He'd surely be able to get into the First Affiliated High School."

"But who told him to be so disobedient before?"

"I only hope now that he can turn over a new leaf after starting high school, study hard, and ask Xixi for guidance more often."

"Xixi is such a great kid." Li Guohong couldn't help but remark. "Old Ying really has a good daughter."

"Yeah," Lin Xiuhong agreed. "Lately, Xixi has been going to the First Affiliated High School's early summer classes, and your son has been running over to her house to play on the computer every day. That's how the gap between people is formed."

"It's summer vacation, it's good to relax a bit more. Didn't Li Luo also accompany us to the shop to help out early every morning?" Li Guohong chuckled twice, then patted his wife's shoulder and got out of bed. "Alright, let's get up."

Li Luo, in the adjacent bedroom, also got up on time to wash up, then followed his parents to the breakfast shop to get busy.

Li Luo himself wasn't particularly concerned, but Lin Xiuhong was a bit absent-minded the entire morning.

From time to time, she would pick up her phone to check the time, and only after confirming that it wasn't ten o'clock yet would she put it down and continue working.

Around nine o'clock, as the number of customers in the shop gradually decreased, Li Luo took his mom's phone and logged into his QQ.

At this moment, their Grade 9 Class 5 group chat was very lively.

Shao Heqi: Everyone, don't forget the graduation ceremony at three in the afternoon. Remember to report to the classroom at school ahead of time. Then in the evening, we'll have a dinner party at Jiangnan Restaurant. Teacher Zhang and the others will be there too.

Shao Heqi: The high school entrance exam results can be checked at ten o'clock. It might be a few minutes early. If you're anxious, you can start calling at 9:50.

Zhao Rongjun: Roger.

Xu Yinghuan: Roger what? Bro, aren't you already in the early classes at the First Affiliated High School!

Jin Yuting: I'm so envious. I don't even know if I can get in.

Li Luo casually scrolled through but had no desire to speak in the group. He only confirmed the time for the school's graduation ceremony in the afternoon.

The other students weren't saying much either.

Aside from the few with the best academic results mentioned above, only some students who didn't care about their scores were joking around in the group.

The others were all nervously awaiting the ten o'clock judgment to descend, with no mind for chatting.

And just as the time neared ten o'clock, Ying Chanxi, who didn't have to go to class on the weekend, also strolled out of her house and found Li Luo at the shop.

"You're here so early today?" Li Luo glanced at Ying Chanxi. "It's not lunchtime yet, is it? Craving fried noodles?"

Ying Chanxi shot him a look and muttered under her breath, "You're asking the obvious."

"Xixi is worried about your results." Lin Xiuhong patted the back of Li Luo's head. "Is it ten o'clock yet? Can we call?"

"Still a few minutes, what's the rush." Li Luo wasn't nervous at all; after all, he knew the contents of the exam paper in advance.

Although he didn't have the reference answers, he already had a rough estimate of his score in mind after finishing the exams.

For instance, on the Chinese paper, because he wasn't sure about a few questions in the reading comprehension and the score for his composition, and wasn't certain he could get full marks on some other questions, Li Luo estimated his score to be a little over 100.

As for the math paper, even with Ying Chanxi's help, Li Luo was still helpless against the last multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank questions.

For the last major question, he managed to solve the first two sub-questions, but the final part was a bit beyond the curriculum.

Even though Li Luo had watched Ying Chanxi solve a similar problem, he couldn't follow the thought process and steps to solve it himself.

When faced with this kind of math problem, if you can't do it, you really can't do it.

He could only barely write down some of the solving steps to see if he could get some partial credit.

But even so, Li Luo estimated that his math score should be around 110.

As for English, the written part was rather simple. After all, as long as he recognized every word and could check the fixed phrases he had memorized beforehand at any time, it wasn't really difficult.

Even for the listening comprehension part, thanks to the record in his memory palace, Li Luo was still able to prepare in advance after spending a lot of brainpower to restore it.

So, as long as his English composition didn't lose too many points, he might even get over 115.

Politics and History went without saying; even if he carelessly lost points somewhere, his total score should be above 45.

Conversely, for Science, because it included many concepts from physics and chemistry, and he had to review both Science and English that night, time was a bit tight.

So he didn't have time to properly ask Ying Chanxi about some of the difficult problems.

This might result in a score that wasn't too high, but out of a total of 180 points, Li Luo estimated he could get at least 140 or more.

Calculated this way, his score would definitely be more than enough for the First Affiliated High School's cutoff, and it would likely be several dozen points higher.

Li Luo originally had the idea of holding back, as this kind of score increase was simply too conspicuous.

But the thought of his parents' proud expressions after he got such a result made Li Luo lose control and perform to his fullest in the examination hall.

Who cares if he'll be suspected? Secure the score first!

No matter what, it's impossible for anyone to guess that he was reborn and possessed an ability like the memory palace.

Zhao Rongjun: Are you not home? I was at your doorstep looking for you, but you weren't there.

Just as Li Luo was lost in thought, a message came through on his phone's QQ.

Li Luo: I'm at my family's shop. Why are you looking for me?

Zhao Rongjun: Oh, I'll come over then.

Zhao Rongjun: Nothing to do on the weekend. Your exam results are coming out, right? I just came over to see.

Li Luo: The independent admissions big shot has come to crush a poor student?

Zhao Rongjun: I'm just concerned about you.

The two chatted casually on QQ.

In less than two minutes, Zhao Rongjun had already arrived at the shop entrance and strode inside.

"Hello, Auntie."

"Ah, Xiao Jun, come sit." Lin Xiuhong beckoned to Zhao Rongjun. "How about you and Xixi have lunch here with us in a bit?"

"Oh, thank you, Auntie."

"What's there to be polite about."

Although Li Luo often went out to play basketball with Zhao Rongjun instead of studying, Lin Xiuhong never had the heart to blame Zhao Rongjun.

After all, with Zhao Rongjun's academic performance consistently in the top thirty of the entire school, it must have been her son Li Luo who was corrupting the good student.

Lin Xiuhong also found it baffling. Her son was great at making friends, with a neighbor like Ying Chanxi who was the class president, and a good buddy like Zhao Rongjun. How come he himself was so disappointing?

If he could just absorb a little bit of his good friends' talent, he wouldn't be struggling to even meet the cutoff score for an ordinary high school.

"Sigh..." Li Luo looked at Ying Chanxi and Zhao Rongjun sitting in front of him and couldn't help but sigh. "With you two sitting here, I'll be too embarrassed to show off in a bit."

After all, given the level of these two, if they had actually taken the high school entrance exam, their total scores would be at least 580 or higher.

Ying Chanxi's level was even above 600.

Even with his cheat, there was no way Li Luo could outscore these academic gods.

At this thought, Li Luo felt a bit dispirited and quickly opened the class group chat on QQ again.

There were still two minutes until ten o'clock sharp, but some students had already successfully called the score inquiry line.

I'm doomed! My total score is only 450. I don't know if I can get into No. 2 High.

This is it... I can't reach the cutoff for ordinary high school. My mom is going to kill me.

I actually scored 505! Is there hope for the First Affiliated High School?

The First Affiliated is a long shot. The cutoff hasn't been as low as 505 in recent years.

What did the vice class president get? And the academic representative? Let us poor students feast our eyes.

Shao Heqi: Checking now, wait a moment.

Xu Yinghuan: 520~ I should be safe, right?

Shao Heqi: My score is out. 554, ranked 87th in the district. It's alright, my usual performance.

His tone was casual, but the words between the lines all conveyed "Aren't I awesome? Hurry up and praise me."

And his classmates appropriately sent words and emojis of praise and envy, flattering Shao Heqi to the point of giddiness.

"Looks like we can check the scores now." Zhao Rongjun also saw the lively scene in the group chat. Seeing the chat history that had already reached 99+, he quickly reminded Li Luo.

"Hurry up." Lin Xiuhong, who was beside him, heard that the scores could be checked and hastily slapped him, telling Li Luo to make the call. "Check it quickly! Are you trying to kill me with anxiety?"

"Don't rush." Li Luo unhurriedly keyed in the score inquiry phone number, then took out his admission ticket from his trouser pocket.

After the call connected, he reported his admission ticket number.

"Okay." After getting a reply, Li Luo hung up the phone. "They'll send a text message in a bit."

"How long will it take?" Lin Xiuhong grew more and more nervous, feeling her heart pounding.

"If it's fast, it should arrive in a minute or two," Li Luo said. Feeling his mom's nervousness, he, who hadn't been very nervous originally, also felt his heart start to beat a little faster.

And Ying Chanxi, who was originally sitting outside the counter, couldn't help but stand up at this moment. She came around from the side and behind the counter, getting close to Li Luo, wanting to see his report card at the earliest possible moment.

Li Luo simply placed the phone on the table and quietly awaited the verdict.

At this moment, Li Guohong from the kitchen brought out a plate of fried noodles, handed it to the customer with the greatest speed of his life, and then ran like the wind to stand behind Li Luo, his eyes glued to the phone screen.

The whole family, plus two contestants who hadn't taken the exam, all had their eyes fixed on the phone.

Half a minute later, with a sudden vibration from the phone, a text message popped up from the top of the screen.

"Quick, quick, quick! Open it and see!" Lin Xiuhong excitedly slapped Li Luo's arm, then covered her eyes. "You guys look first, you guys look first. Xixi, after you see it, tell me if it's good or not."

Ying Chanxi reached out her hand and tapped open the text message.

On it, Li Luo's scores were clearly written—

Examinee: Li Luo.

Admission Ticket No.: xxxxxxxx

Chinese: 110

Math: 112

English: 114

Science: 142

Politics & History: 47

Physical Education: 30

Total Score: 555

District Rank: 86th

Seeing this series of numbers before her, Ying Chanxi's eyes widened, her mouth fell slightly open, and for a moment, she forgot to speak.

"Xixi, how is it?" Lin Xiuhong, who still hadn't dared to look at the report card, asked anxiously.

"Um..." Ying Chanxi subconsciously swallowed, feeling her throat tighten and her head feel slightly dizzy as a sort of immense surprise blossomed in her mind. "Li Luo... he did... very, very, very well..."
